name: Project Showcase – A WordPress Plugin to Display Projects in Various Layouts
author: GS Plugins

sections.description:
GS Projects Plugin is a flexible WordPress plugin for displaying projects in clean, responsive portfolio layouts. It helps you present project items in an organized manner without requiring a custom code.

The plugin is designed to work with standard WordPress structures and offers multiple layout options suitable for agencies, freelancers, developers, and creative portfolios. You can control how projects appear, how much information is displayed, and how they are grouped, which makes it easier to highlight important work across your site.

The GS Projects Plugin focuses on simplicity and performance. It integrates smoothly with most WordPress themes and page builders, allowing you to create structured project showcases that adapt well to different screen sizes. Whether you want to display recent projects, featured work, or categorized portfolios, the plugin provides a practical way to manage project presentations.

🎬 Live Demo ⬆️ Upgrade to PRO 📚 Documentation 🙋‍♂️ Support

Why do well-organized project layouts make a difference?

As a portfolio grows, managing and presenting projects in a clear way becomes more important. A structured layout helps visitors explore your work more easily and understand each project at a glance.

  • Help visitors scan projects quickly and discover relevant work.
  • Keep multiple projects visually organized and easy to browse.
  • Highlight important or featured projects naturally.
  • Improve consistency across desktop and mobile devices.
  • Reduce clutter compared to long, unstructured project lists.

What makes the GS Projects Plugin practical to use?

  • Simple and familiar setup: GS Projects Plugin works smoothly within WordPress, making it easy to showcase projects without changing your workflow. Manage project displays using simple settings while keeping full control over your portfolio.
  • Flexible display options: Display projects on any page or post using layouts that adapt to different portfolio needs, such as recent projects or category based work.
  • Clean and responsive layouts: Projects appear in organized layouts that adjust smoothly across desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
  • Better project organization: Group and structure projects visually so visitors can browse your work easily without clutter.

The GS Projects Plugin offers a practical way to present projects while keeping your portfolio clean, organized, and easy to manage.

Core features of GS Projects Plugin

The GS Projects Plugin provides a focused set of tools to organize, manage, and display projects in structured portfolio layouts while keeping setup and management simple.

  • Project portfolio display in organized layouts.
  • Multiple layout variations for project showcases.
  • Project category grouping and filtering.
  • Control number of projects displayed.
  • Project ordering by date, title, ID, or custom order.
  • Featured image support for project thumbnails.
  • Toggle display of title, description, and project details.
  • Responsive column controls for all devices.
  • Theme compatible and consistent layouts.
  • Shortcode based project placement.
  • Widget support for displaying projects.
  • Page builder and theme compatibility.
  • Lightweight structure with optimized assets.
  • Custom CSS support for layout styling.
  • Standard WordPress structure compatibility.
  • Localization ready.
  • Developer-friendly and standards-compliant markup.
  • No code setup required.

There are numerous additional options available to support different project showcase needs.

Who is the GS Projects Plugin best suited for?

The GS Projects Plugin is ideal for users who need a structured and flexible way to showcase projects or portfolio items without custom development.

  • Freelancers who want to present their projects in clean, organized layouts
  • Agencies showcasing client work or case studies
  • Developers displaying completed projects or technical work
  • Designers and creatives building a professional portfolio website
  • Website owners who prefer shortcode or widget based project management

GS Projects Plugin works especially well when clarity, organization, and professional project presentation are more important than complex design effects.

Available fields to add info

  • Project Name
  • Project Details
  • Skill
  • Project URL
  • Client Review
  • Client Rating
  • Project Group / Category
  • Project Image
  • Youtube Video ID
  • Vimeo Video ID
  • Image Gallery
  • Project Image (default) / Youtube / Vimeo / Gallery

General Settings

Go to GS Projects → Shortcode to create or edit a shortcode. The General Settings tab allows you to control the basic layout, structure, and content display of your project showcase.

Set a Shortcode Name to identify your shortcode easily. Choose a Theme and View Type to define how your projects will appear on the frontend.

Control how project items behave using the Link Type and Link Target options. Select appropriate Image Sizes to keep project thumbnails consistent across your layout.

You can enable or disable elements such as Project Title, Project Subtitle, and Project Details, while Title Limit helps control the length of project titles for cleaner layouts.

The Control Details option allows you to decide which project information should be displayed within each project item.

These settings help you configure how projects are structured and displayed while keeping the setup simple and flexible.

Style Settings

The Style Settings tab allows you to control the visual layout and typography of your project’s showcase.

Adjust the number of projects displayed per row using Desktop, Tablet, Portrait Mobile, and Mobile Items to ensure the layout adapts properly across different screen sizes.

Typography options such as Title Typography, Subtitle Typography, and Details Typography lets you customize the appearance of project titles, subtitles, and project details for better readability and visual consistency.

Query Settings

The Query Settings tab allows you to control which projects are displayed and how they are organized in the showcase.

Set the number of projects to display using the Projects option. Use Order By and Order to define how projects are sorted, such as by date, title, or custom order.

For filter navigation, Filter Order By and Filter Order help control how project filters are arranged.

You can also refine the results using Exclude/Include options for Project Category and Project Tag, allowing you to display only specific groups of projects or hide selected ones from the layout.

Page Builder Support

  • Gutenberg.
  • Elementor.
  • WPBakery.
  • Divi Builders.
  • Beaver Builder.
  • Oxygen Builder.
  • UX Builder.
  • TagDiv.
  • Genesis.

GS Projects shortcode usage

Select a theme, view type & other parameters. Shortcode will generate with id like:

[gsprojects id=1]

Shortcode PHP Usage

<?php echo do_shortcode( '[gsprojects id=3]' ); ?>

Documentation

If you have any questions regarding the GS Projects Plugin and how to work with it, we recommend referring to our comprehensive online documentation. It provides detailed information and instructions to help you navigate and use the plugin effectively. You can find the Documentation here.

Quick Support & Bug Reporting

If you encounter any problems or discover bugs, please post them in our Support channel. We aim to respond as soon as possible (excluding holidays).

Pro users are requested to contact our support channel for dedicated assistance.

🙋‍♂️ Alternatively, you can reach out to us through our Support or WordPress.org support forum.

sections.installation:
Install GS Project plugin as a regular WordPress plugin. Here is different ways to install GS Projects plugin :

  • Visual Installation & Usage Guide »

Install by Search Plugin

  • In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
  • Search GS Projects
  • Click to install
  • Activate the plugin
  • GS Projects post type will show below POSTS

Install by Upload Plugin

  • Download the latest version of GS Projects (.zip file)
  • In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
  • Select Upload Plugin
  • Click on Choose File
  • Select downloaded gs-projects-pro.zip & click on Install Now button
  • Activate the plugin
  • GS Projects post type will show below Posts / Pages

Install Plugin using FTP

  • Upload gs-projects-pro folder inside the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Go to WordPress dashboard > Plugins > Activate the GS Projects plugin

  • GS Projects post type will show below Posts / Pages

  • Put [gsprojects id=1] shortcode or select another theme, where you need to show the Projects.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new Project?

GS Projects post type will show below Posts / Pages. To add a new Project, go to GS Projects > Add New Project, then add Title, Desc, Category, Skills, Project URL, Client review & ratings, Project Image / Gallery, Youtube / Vimeo video. Now you are ready to Publish.

What will be the Project image dimension?

Recommended image size 400px X 400px for perfect view of various devices.

How to use shortcode inside page templates?

WordPress has a great function, do_shortcode(), that will allow you to use shortcodes inside your theme files. For example, to output Projects in a Theme file, you would do this:

<?php echo do_shortcode('[gsprojects id=1]'); ?>
